description: Chemistry Studio 2.5.6 release and the offline bootstrap pin that the cross-repo check compares.
problem: The marketplace merged 2.5.6 (NodusResearch/nodus-research-skill-marketplace#40) and its catalog advertised chemistry-studio-v2.5.6 before any release existed; the bootstrap pinned 2.5.1; the catalog size (19,450,683) was 2.5.1's. All three cross-repo jobs failed on main and on this PR.

compatibility.finding: 2.5.6's SKILL.md forbade the reactants>agents>products reaction lines that Nodus 5.6.0 appends to a route request (shared/synthesisPrompt.ts at v5.6.0), while declaring minNodusVersion 5.3.2. The worker's tool inputs are unchanged since 2.5.1.
compatibility.decision: Make the synthesis section follow whichever contract the application appends and keep minNodusVersion 5.3.2. Raising it to 5.7.0 would make every 5.6.0 checkout refuse the package (cross-repo, capability migration, the 5.6.1-research installer candidate) until package.json moves.
compatibility.marketplacePullRequest: NodusResearch/nodus-research-skill-marketplace#41, merged 5367d684 after validate.yml and package tests passed; new contract test fails on the previous SKILL.md

release.verified: signature with packages/capability-api verifyReleaseManifest against electron/capabilities/trustedKeys.json; downloaded asset size and SHA-256 equal to the manifest; packaged plugin.json minNodusVersion 5.3.2; packaged SKILL.md carries the corrected synthesis section

verification: NODUS_REQUIRE_BOOTSTRAP=1 npm run capabilities:bootstrap: 3 packages bundled
npm run verify:cross-repo against marketplace main 24bef77: CROSS-REPO PASS
npm run verify:capability-migration: CAPABILITY MIGRATION PASS
#942 CI: cross-repo passed on macos-14, ubuntu-latest and windows-latest

version5_6_2: No 5.6.2 reference exists in either repository, the PR or the issue; package.json stays 5.6.0. The research installer candidate stays 5.6.1-research.N. compareSemver treats a pre-release patch as NaN, so a future 5.7.0-research.N candidate would reject any package whose minNodusVersion is 5.7.0.
